claims.text: Role in pituitary adenoma: prolactinoma: cabergoline = tx of choice (better tolerated and more potent than bromocriptine);
claims.quote: Cabergoline is the treatment of choice because it is more easily tolerated (has a lower frequency of adverse effects) and more potent than bromocriptine.

claims.text: stop it at a positive preg test if trying to conceive;
claims.quote: Adult females who are trying to become pregnant should stop cabergoline or bromocriptine use at the time of a positive pregnancy test result.

claims.text: acromegaly: cabergoline is typically used in mild dz.
claims.quote: Cabergoline is typically used in mild disease

claims.text: Cautions: high doses (esp cabergoline) are thought to have caused valvular heart dz in PD;
claims.quote: High doses of dopamine agonists, particularly cabergoline, are thought to have caused valvular heart disease in some patients with Parkinson disease.

claims.text: consider echo surveillance, esp > 3 mg/wk;
claims.quote: echocardiographic surveillance should be considered, especially when doses > 3 mg per week are used

claims.text: may cause ↑impulsivity and occasionally psychosis.
claims.quote: Dopamine agonists in the doses used for hyperprolactinemia also sometimes cause behavioral and psychiatric changes, characterized by increased impulsivity and occasionally psychosis

claims.text: Cabergoline dose, hyperprolactinemic disorders: Start 0.25 mg PO twice weekly.
claims.quote: The recommended starting dosage of cabergoline tablets is 0.25 mg orally twice weekly.

claims.text: Titrate by ↑ 0.25 mg twice weekly at intervals of no less than 4 wks to achieve normal serum prolactin.
claims.quote: Titrate cabergoline tablets to achieve normal serum prolactin levels by increasing cabergoline tablets by 0.25 mg orally twice weekly at intervals of no less than 4 weeks.

claims.text: Max 1 mg twice weekly.
claims.quote: The maximum recommended dosage is 1 mg orally, twice weekly

claims.text: Cabergoline safety: CI: uncontrolled hypertension; known hypersensitivity to ergot derivatives.
claims.quote: Uncontrolled hypertension. Known hypersensitivity to ergot derivatives.

claims.text: CI: Hx of cardiac valvular disorders (valvulopathy of any valve shown on pre-tx evaluation, incl echocardiography) or pericardial fibrosis; Hx of pleural, pulmonary, or retroperitoneal fibrotic disorders.
claims.quote: History of cardiac valvular disorders, as suggested by anatomical evidence of valvulopathy of any valve, determined by pre-treatment evaluation including echocardiographic demonstration of valve leaflet thickening, valve restriction, or mixed valve restriction-stenosis, or history of pericardial fibrosis [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.1)] . History of pleural, pulmonary, or retroperitoneal fibrotic disorders

claims.text: B4 initiating, evaluate for valvular heart disease, incl w/ an echocardiogram; if valvular disease is detected, ⍉ administer.
claims.quote: Before initiating cabergoline tablets evaluate for valvular heart disease, including with an echocardiogram. If valvular disease is detected, do not administer cabergoline tablets.
claims.locator: 2.1 Recommended Evaluation Before Initiating Cabergoline Tablets

claims.text: Monitor for valvulopathy w/ a cardiac echocardiogram at intervals of 6 to 12 mo or as clinically indicated.
claims.quote: monitor for the development of valvulopathy with a cardiac echocardiogram at intervals of 6 to 12 months or as clinically indicated

claims.text: If pleural, pericardial, retroperitoneal, or pulmonary fibrosis occur, discontinue.
claims.quote: If pleural, pericardial, retroperitoneal, or pulmonary fibrosis occur, discontinue cabergoline tablets.

claims.text: Check BP at baseline and during tx and monitor for orthostatic hypotension; warn pts about the risk and precautions when rising from a supine or sitting position.
claims.quote: Check blood pressure at baseline and during treatment with cabergoline tablets and monitor for orthostatic hypotension. Warn patients about the risk of orthostatic hypotension and precautions to take when rising from a supine or sitting position.

claims.text: Specifically ask pts about new or increased gambling urges, sexual urges, uncontrolled spending, or other urges; consider dose reduction or stopping if such urges develop.
claims.quote: Because patients may not recognize impulse control and compulsive behaviors as abnormal, it is important for health care providers to specifically ask patients about the development of new or increased gambling urges, sexual urges, uncontrolled spending, or other urges while being treated with cabergoline tablets. Consider dosage reduction or stopping cabergoline tablets if a patient develops such urges while taking cabergoline tablets.
claims.locator: 5.5 Impulse Control Disorders and Compulsive Behaviors

claims.text: ⍉ use for inhibition or suppression of postpartum physiologic lactation (risk of serious adverse reactions).
claims.quote: Avoid use of cabergoline tablets for the inhibition or suppression of postpartum physiologic lactation because of the risk of serious adverse reactions.
claims.locator: 5.4 Risks with Use of Cabergoline Tablets for Postpartum Lactation Inhibition or Suppression

claims.text: Not recommended w/ D2-antagonists such as phenothiazines, butyrophenones, thioxanthenes, or metoclopramide.
claims.quote: Cabergoline tablets, a dopamine receptor agonist, is not recommended for concomitant use with D2-antagonists, such as phenothiazines, butyrophenones, thioxanthenes, or metoclopramide.

claims.text: Severe hepatic impairment (Child-Pugh C) not recommended; in moderate HI (Child-Pugh B) increase monitoring of cabergoline-associated adverse reactions.
claims.quote: The use of cabergoline tablets in patients with severe hepatic impairment (HI) (Child-Pugh C) is not recommended. When using cabergoline tablets in patients with moderate HI (Child-Pugh B) increase monitoring of cabergoline tablets-associated adverse reactions.

claims.text: OD: take measures to support BP if necessary.
claims.quote: Take measures to support blood pressure, if necessary.
